verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that Teams delivers chat-based collaboration alongside meetings, calling, and enterprise voice (ms-teams-docs-18). Community users describe in-app calls with video and mute controls, which corroborates that calling exists (ms-teams-comm-10, ms-teams-comm-6). However, nothing in the evidence shows calls being started directly from a channel or DM, and the community reports of buggy call controls point to reliability problems rather than absence of the feature. missing for 10: documentation of starting audio/video calls from a channel or DM, explicit audio vs video call initiation flow, admin-persona specifics, reliable hands-on corroboration.
